# P1.05 — Timeline, run cards, live feed, walkthrough, run report

Spec: `docs/tickets/33_P1.05__timeline-run-cards-reports.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.05.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` + `worker` to `dev`,
bounded live verify, $0 baseline) is operator-gated → **D-P1.05-1**.

## Summary

The Timeline pane is the §5.5 round log rendered as run rows: the three verbs (`Draft ▾ Review ▾
Revise ▾` — each opens the run sheet), the next-step card on top (the §6.3 state function's verb +
estimate), then rounds grouped by subject draft (newest round first, oldest run first, `vN` chips,
the Outline/Imported-draft chip below the oldest, ungrouped runs after). Run cards carry the full
six-state table — orchestrator facts only (phase glyphs ✓/◐/○, counters, credits vs cap, ETA band,
queue position, deliverable chips, refund line, walkthrough state, failure code) with **no
agent-authored progress text anywhere** (REQ-IDE-11). The Desk's Live feed renders all three
densities through one shared SSR/browser formatter, Verbose behind `data-tier="advanced"`. Steering
is real: pause-after-phase parks at the next committed boundary, resume/resume-with-note/queue-note
write `Guidance{queued_message}`, stop keeps partials. A delivered run lazily generates a ≤200-word
model-written walkthrough (one package-class call, `walkthrough:<runId>` singleton, mechanical word
cap, failed state retries only via the explicit retry). `/p/:project/r/:run#report` renders the
Level-3 run report (estimate-vs-actual, server-computed flags, phase bars, seat split with subagent
labels, claims + cost-per-verified-claim, cost drivers, suggested guidance); Level 4 (phase × seat ×
model-tier + tokens + provider request ids) loads only on the Advanced disclosure, and `/app/usage/
r/:run` redirects to the canonical anchor.

## What landed

**`packages/db`** — migration `0030_timeline_steering.sql` (`runs.pause_requested_at`,
`runs.paused_at`, `runs.walkthrough` jsonb) + Drizzle parity.

**`packages/orchestrator`** — `steering.ts`: `requestPause` (flags a `running` run), the commitStep
boundary hook (in-flight phase commits, then `running → waiting_gate` + `paused_at`, no gate),
`resumeRun` (parked `waiting_gate → queued`, attempt++, optional same-tx note; a real gate wait
answers `gate_waiting`), `queueNote`. `walkthrough.ts`: the job contract + `walkthrough:<runId>`
singleton shape.

**`apps/worker`** — `run.walkthrough` job + `walkthrough-generator.ts`: one `claude-haiku-4-5` call
(≤400 max tokens) over artifact identity/shape + structured run facts only; 200-word cap enforced
mechanically; failure persists `status:'failed'` metadata instead of looping.
`WALKTHROUGH_MODEL_KEY_SECRET` reads through worker env only.

**`packages/findings-core`** — `timeline.ts` (`groupRounds` + `nextStepVerb`), `run-card.ts`
extended (six states, paused-vs-gate split, deliverables, refund, queued-notes count, `etaBandForPhases`),
`run-report.ts` (Level-3 read model + Level-4 drill-down; flags computed server-side from the
templated trigger strings).

**`packages/ide`** — `feed-row.ts`: the shared event→row formatter (density filter, fail-closed for
uncatalogued types, whitelisted payload fields only).

**`apps/api`** — `timeline-routes.ts`: `GET /projects/:id/timeline` (grouped rounds + cards + lazy
walkthrough enqueue over grouped AND ungrouped runs + the next-step estimate), `GET /runs/:id/report`
(+`?advanced=1`), `GET /runs/:id/events` JSON, steering POSTs (`pause`/`resume`/`notes`/`stop`/
`walkthrough/retry`). Mounted in `index.ts`; DTOs + client methods in `@rhema/api-client`.

**`apps/web`** — `data.ts`/`page-data.ts` seam (best-effort timeline/feed loads — the project page
degrades, never fails); `server.ts`: `/p/:project/r/:runId` report page inside the IDE shell,
`/events` SSE proxy (session forwarded server-side; `after` + `Last-Event-ID` ride through),
steering POSTs that swallow stale 400/404/409 → redirect to `/p/:slug`, `/app/usage/r/:run` →
canonical `#report` redirect; `feed-labels.ts` copy maps; `client/ide.ts` EventSource island
(replay via `?after`, Last-Event-ID reconnect); `pages.tsx`/`copy.ts` Timeline + RunReport wiring.

**`packages/ui`** — `timeline.tsx` (`TimelinePane`: verbs row, next-step card, collapsed round
summaries — numeric/server facts only, `vN` chips, origin chip), `run-card.tsx` extended (all six
states' lines + action forms + note input), `run-report.tsx` (L3 + Advanced disclosure → `?advanced=1`).
